# Third-party files

The studio page that `tilegen serve` shows is served whole from the binary,
so it works with no network. These files are redistributed unchanged under
their own licences.

| File | Project | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `react.production.min.js` | React | 18.3.1 | MIT |
| `react-dom.production.min.js` | React DOM | 18.3.1 | MIT |
| `htm.js` | htm | 3.1.1 | Apache-2.0 |
| `highlight.min.js`, `hljs-protobuf.min.js`, `hljs-lisp.min.js` | highlight.js | 11.9.0 | BSD-3-Clause |
| `jszip.min.js` | JSZip | 3.10.1 | MIT |
| `mermaid.min.js` | Mermaid | 11.17.2 | MIT |
| `fonts/bricolage-grotesque-*.woff2` | Bricolage Grotesque | Fontsource 5.3.0 | OFL-1.1 |
| `fonts/ibm-plex-sans-*.woff2`, `fonts/ibm-plex-mono-*.woff2` | IBM Plex | Fontsource 5.3.0 | OFL-1.1 |
